title: 第一章 秦苏第二章 爷爷秦德顺
slug: 武道每日加点打更人肝成人间武圣
content_zh:
大雍，承平一十三年。
江夏郡，安陆县。
三九的寒风卷着落叶，扫过归一武馆的大门。
“师兄，如果您不嫌弃，您和武馆的师傅说一下，我每次过来占武馆一角，习武的家伙我自备，人多我就离远一点，人少的时候，我凑近一点，不耽误教徒弟，您看这样行吗？”
秦苏对着归一武馆的一名师兄恭敬说道。
那名刚开门的师兄听到这话，又看了秦苏一眼，顿时明白秦苏是没钱学武又想白嫖的人。
这种人，他不知道见过多少，说什么的都有，就是没钱。
想进武馆，没钱，没门。
“没钱还想习武？赶紧滚，别挡门。”
果然不行，秦苏叹了口气，没在说话，对着他拱了拱手，转身离开，背影萧瑟。
秦苏并不是这个世界的人。
他从蓝星穿越到这同名同姓的秦苏身上，已经十天。
前世他是一名九八五的高材生，一场见义勇为，再睁眼，就来到了这里。
原身因为一场风寒没有挺过来，便宜了秦苏。
过了几天，他才逐渐理顺了原身的记忆，适应了这个世界。
这是一处武道为尊的世界，自己是安陆县外城刚刚上任不到一个月的打更人。
这份差事是父亲留给秦苏的，上个月，秦苏的二叔，也就是他爹的弟弟被官府选中，要服徭役。
他跑来求秦苏他爹替他，软磨硬泡，还是答应了。
他爹把差事过到秦苏名下，自己去了，至今一个月，杳无音信。
虽然吃的是皇粮，但是也只能混个温饱，更别说秦苏还有一个未过门的媳妇。

秦苏的母亲在几年前就得了肺痨走了。
这个世界，活着都很艰难。
身为穿越过来的秦苏，自然是想要改变这一切。
秦苏不是没想过凭借现代知识创业经商，但是在这门阀世家林立，强取豪夺的世界，一个没有背景的白丁刚冒出头，顷刻间就会人死财空。
而想要逆天改命，只有练武。
自身的强大，才是真正的强大。
武者。
只要入了武道，登了武籍，便能全免杂捐徭役，街头帮派不敢轻易上门滋扰，就连县衙小吏也要礼让三分。
练出真本事，上可赴武科入仕，下可入世家富户做护院，月入数两甚至十几两白银。
可是武道，有根骨的人十不存一，能入武道者，更是少之又少。
但是，这对秦苏来说，不是最大的难题。
身为穿越者的秦苏，在他的脑海中有一道符箓：【业精于勤，终有所成】
付出必有回报，重复铸就非凡。
这是他在这乱世里，唯一的底牌。
【姓名：秦苏】
【境界：凡人】
【根骨：10】
content_en:
Dayong, the thirteenth year of Taiping.
Jiangxia County, Anlu County.
The cold wind of Sanjiu swept the fallen leaves and swept past the gate of Guiyi Martial Arts Hall.
"Senior brother, if you don't mind, you can tell the master of the martial arts school that every time I come over to occupy a corner of the martial arts studio, I will prepare my own martial arts guys. If there are many people, I will stay away. When there are few people, I will come closer so as not to delay the training of the disciples. Do you think this is okay?"
Qin Su said respectfully to a senior fellow from Guiyi Martial Arts School.
When the senior brother who just opened the door heard this, he glanced at Qin Su again, and immediately understood that Qin Su was someone who had no money to learn martial arts and wanted to have sex for nothing.
He didn't know how many people he had seen like this. They said everything, but they had no money.
I want to enter a martial arts gym, but if I don’t have money, there’s no way.
"You still want to practice martial arts when you don't have money? Get out of here and don't block the door."
As expected, it didn't work. Qin Su sighed and said nothing. He cupped his hands in front of him, turned around and left, his back looking bleak.
Qin Su is not from this world.
It has been ten days since he traveled from Blue Star to Qin Su with the same name.
In his previous life, he was a top student in the 1980s. He acted bravely for a righteous cause, and when he opened his eyes again, he came here.
The original person did not survive the cold, which gave Qin Su an advantage.
After a few days, he gradually sorted out his original memory and adapted to this world.
This is a world where martial arts is respected. I am a watchman in the outer city of Anlu County who has just taken office less than a month ago.
This job was left to Qin Su by his father. Last month, Qin Su's second uncle, his father's younger brother, was selected by the government to serve as a corvee.
He came to ask Qin Su's father to take over for him. After much hard work, he finally agreed.
His father transferred the errand to Qin Su's name and left by himself. There has been no news for a month.
Although he was eating royal food, he could only make ends meet, not to mention that Qin Su had a daughter-in-law who had not yet married.
Qin Su's mother died of tuberculosis a few years ago.
In this world, life is difficult.
As Qin Su, who has traveled through time, he naturally wants to change everything.
It's not that Qin Su hasn't thought about starting a business with modern knowledge, but in this world where there are many powerful families and robbery, if an idiot with no background just shows up, he will die in an instant and lose all his money.
If you want to change your destiny against the will of heaven, you can only practice martial arts.
Your own strength is the real strength.
Warrior.
As long as you enter martial arts and register as a martial artist, you will be exempted from all miscellaneous labor and labor. Street gangs do not dare to come and cause trouble easily, and even county officials must be polite.
If you develop your true skills, you can go to the martial arts department and become an official, or you can work as a nurse in a wealthy family, earning a few taels or even more than a dozen taels of silver a month.
But in martial arts, only one out of ten people has the guts to do so, and those who can enter martial arts are even rarer.
However, this is not the biggest problem for Qin Su.
As a time traveler, Qin Su has a talisman in his mind: [If you are diligent and diligent, you will eventually achieve something]
Efforts will be rewarded, and repetition creates extraordinary things.
This is his only trump card in this troubled world.
[Name: Qin Su]
[Realm: Mortal]
【Root bone: 10】
